name: Living Well in Blackpool - Support Hub
location: Layton Methodist Church, Westcliffe Drive, FY3 7DZ
body: A weekly drop-in offering wraparound support with money, employment, housing, food, health, family worries and learning new skills. Free continental breakfast until 11am. Free - no appointment needed, just turn up.

name: Infant Essentials
location: 5 Grenfell Ave, Layton, FY3 7BP
body: Nappies, formula, infant toiletries, donated clothing and other essentials for parents and carers of infants in Layton and Grange Park.

name: Layton Larder
location: Layton Methodist Church, Westcliffe Drive, FY3 7DZ
hours: Order Saturday from 10.30am · collect the following week
body: £3 per recipe pack · serves up to 4 · all ingredients included · easy to cook. Hosted by Layton Methodist (Forward Project) - the same team behind our food bank.

name: Wholesome Wednesdays
location: Layton Methodist Forward Centre · Westcliffe Drive, FY3 7DZ
body: Main from £3.95 · Main + pudding + brew £5.95. Gluten free and veggie options available. All welcome.

name: Oasis Café
location: Layton Methodist Forward Centre · Westcliffe Drive, FY3 7DZ
body: Café prices · warm space · friendly faces. Drop in any time.

name: Salvation Army - Bridge Project (Homeless Hub)
location: Salvation Army, Raikes Parade, Blackpool FY1 4EL
hours: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday, Friday · 9am-11am breakfast & hot shower · 12pm-2pm hot meal
body: Homeless hub drop-in for adults 26 and over - separate from the Salvation Army's £3 community lunch below.
linkText: Find the Bridge Project on Facebook →

name: Street Life - The Base
location: 48 Buchanan Street, Blackpool
hours: Monday-Friday · Cook & Eat, drop-ins and activities · menu changes weekly
body: 18-25 years only. Free hot food every weekday - fry ups, pasta bakes, fish finger butties and more. Drop in or join an activity.

name: Salvation Army community lunch
location: Raikes Parade, Blackpool FY1 4EL · 01253 626114
body: 2-course hot meal with sweet and drink · £1. Short bus ride from Layton.

name: Helping Hearts Blackpool
location: Boothly Road, Blackpool (just outside Layton)
hours: Thursday 3:30pm-5:30pm families & 60+ (quieter) · 6:15pm evening session, open to everyone
body: A free hot meal every Thursday - no referral needed, open year-round to anyone in Blackpool, Fylde and Wyre. Also: food bank, baby bank, pet food bank, clothing, toiletries, hot showers and sanitary products.

name: Blackpool Street Angels
location: Bank Street Car Park, Blackpool FY1 2DT
body: Free hot meal and takeaway food from the street outreach team. Evening drop-in, everyone welcome.
linkText: Find Blackpool & the Fylde Street Angels on Facebook →

name: Comfort C.A.F.E.
location: St Thomas' Church, 135 Caunce St, Blackpool FY1 3NJ
body: Free hot meal and takeaway food. For adults 18 and over.
linkText: Find St Thomas' Church on Facebook →

name: St Peter's Church
location: 190 Lytham Road, Blackpool FY1 6DJ
body: Free hot meal, fruit, cakes and a hot drink. Open to people of any age.
linkText: Find St Peter's Church, South Shore →

name: Holy Cross Church
location: Central Drive, Blackpool FY1 6LA
body: Free hot meal and takeaway food.
linkText: Find Holy Cross Church on Facebook →

name: Games and a Cuppa / Warm Hub
location: St Thomas' Church, 135 Caunce St, Blackpool FY1 3NJ
body: Free meal and social time - games and a cuppa, becoming Warm Hub through the colder months. Especially popular with older folk, but everyone's welcome.
linkText: Find St Thomas' Church on Facebook →

name: The Big Food Truck
location: Layton Methodist Church · Westcliffe Drive, FY3 7DZ
body: Text your name to register - they'll confirm your order by text before each week. Free to join, free to use.

name: Mobile Pantry - Argosy Court
location: Argosy Court, FY3 7PW
body: Spend £5-10 on tins, packaged food, and toiletries - then choose free bakery, fruit, veg, dairy and frozen food. Your haul will be worth around £20-25. No referral needed.

name: Free Surplus Food Stall
location: Layton Methodist, Westcliffe Drive, FY3 7DZ
body: Free surplus food - open to everyone, no questions asked. Come along, see what's available, and be part of the community. Subject to availability.

name: Helping Hearts Blackpool - Food Bank
location: Boothly Road, Blackpool (just outside Layton)
body: Runs a food bank alongside their weekly hot meal - no referral needed. Also covers baby bank, pet food bank, clothing and toiletries.

name: Claremont First Steps
location: Methodist Church Building, Dickson Road, Blackpool FY1 2AP
body: Free takeaway food for anyone in need, no referral required.
linkText: Find Claremont First Step Community Centre on Facebook →

name: Sacred Heart Church
location: 17 Talbot Road, Blackpool FY1 1LB (green doors at church house)
body: Free emergency food.
linkText: Find Sacred Heart Church on Facebook →

name: Community Grocery Blackpool
location: Kings Church · 241 Bispham Road · Blackpool FY2 0LB
body: £5 annual membership · then £4 per shop · your basket is worth £20-25. No proof of income. No ID required. Just turn up and join. On several bus routes from Layton.

name: Pet Bank (Helping Hearts Blackpool)
location: Boothly Road, Blackpool (just outside Layton)
body: Struggling to feed a pet? Helping Hearts run a pet food bank alongside their food bank, baby bank and weekly hot meal - no referral needed.
